target_customer: Operators and owners of commercial electric vehicles in India (about 2 million vehicles cited)
problem: Battery cost is the main barrier for commercial EV owners; Enerjazz is building a battery swapping network so owners pay per use instead of buying packs.
business_model: Battery swapping network (energy as a service, per swap)

founders.name: Ravi Bharahoke
prior_employers: Shell (8.5 years in strategy, operations and analytics)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Aggregators list a second founder, Pratik Ranjan Das, but no company or YC source confirms it.

competitors.name: SUN Mobility
competitors.what: Battery swapping infrastructure and services for commercial electric vehicles in India
competitors.traction_then: Targeting 500 swap points in India by end of 2022
competitors.funding_then: $50M from Vitol in October 2021 (months after the batch)

competitors.name: Battery Smart
competitors.what: Battery swapping for electric two and three wheelers in India
competitors.funding_then: $7M pre Series A led by Blume Ventures and Orios in November 2021 (months after the batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Swapping needs battery pack design, a management system and a station network; the YC page says patent pending technology, but hardware and logistics are demanding for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A dense station network can create local network effects, but it requires heavy capital and rivals with far more funding were already building.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Better funded swap operators scaled in 2021; no source shows an acquisition of Enerjazz.

market_need_then: India pushed commercial EV adoption and the founder argued affordable storage would matter most over decades; funded rivals raised in late 2021, indicating investor demand.

brand_strength.rationale: No sources about the brand were found.

outcome_analysis: Enerjazz is an early stage Indian battery swapping company founded by a former Shell strategy analyst that went through YC in Summer 2021. Public sources show little after the batch: no verified round, no exit and no shutdown. Competitors such as SUN Mobility and Battery Smart raised larger rounds in late 2021, so capital intensity and competition are the main open risks, but the outcome is not visible.
notes: Company site fetch was blocked by a rate limited domain safety check and not retried. Aggregators (Inc42, PitchBook, Seedtable) list $125K from YC in August or September 2021 and an earlier seed around September 2018 of about $131K; aggregator only and unverified, so not recorded as rounds. Aggregators say founded 2018 in Noida; YC says 2021. Esmito named as competitor in an undated Extruct profile only. Battery Smart serves two and three wheelers, so overlap is partial.
